title: Normalized tensor pullback: OpenTriangle
statement: Let $A,B,C$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $j:A\to B$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $b:B\to C$, $d:A\to C$ morphisms with $b\circ j=d$, and $F$ an $\mathcal O_C$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P_b$ for tensor-formula module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and $\eta_b$ for its chosen canonical adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There is an isomorphism $e:(P_bF)|_A\cong P_dF$ whose map on global sections sends the restriction to $j(A)$ of $\eta_b(F)(s)$, for each $s\in\Gamma(C,F)$, to the global section $\eta_d(F)(s)$ restricted to the top open. Restriction is the open-immersion module restriction [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], and the top section is [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison].

source.place: Tags 0096 (lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules) and 0097 (lemma-push-pull-composition-modules); expanded canonical unit calculation, as used in Tag 0BED

proof.text: Identify restriction along j with tensor pullback along j using the leftAdjointUniq comparison of the restriction and chosen tensor adjunctions. Compose with tensorSectionsComp j b and transport along h to construct e.

Evaluate the restriction comparison unit equation on the top open of B and the composition comparison unit equation on the top open of C. The first equation turns restriction to j(A) into the j unit. The second identifies the successive b and j units with the j followed by b unit. Inverse image of the top open contributes an identity restriction; equality transport along h yields the d unit.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_tensorPullback_openTriangle {A B C : Scheme.{w}}
    (j : A ⟶ B) [IsOpenImmersion j] (b : B ⟶ C) (d : A ⟶ C)
    (h : j ≫ b = d) (F : C.Modules) :
    ∃ e : ((tensorPullback b).obj F).restrict j ≅ (tensorPullback d).obj F,
      ∀ (s : Γ(F, ⊤)),
        e.hom.app ⊤
          (((tensorPullback b).obj F).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (by simp : j ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction b)).unit.app F).app ⊤ s)) =
          tensorPullbackTopSection d F s
